context: The plugin bundles a router skill, a lens-authoring skill, a respond skill, and four review lenses. The only install path is the Tessl Review GitHub App, which starts on the organization's Code reviews page in the Tessl web app. This scenario checks that a request asking for a GitHub Action is still treated as an App install, and that no workflow is written in its place.

checklist.name: Recognises the install job
checklist.description: plan.md states that this is a Code Review install job handled by the code-review skill's install path, and says the Tessl Review GitHub App is how Code Review is installed

checklist.name: No workflow written
checklist.description: No file is added under .github/workflows/, and no file anywhere references tesslio/code-review-action or runs tessl code review from a workflow

checklist.name: Points at the Code reviews page
checklist.description: plan.md directs the user to the organization's Code reviews page, https://tessl.io/orgs/<id>/code-reviews with the organization id from tessl org list --json, and gives no github.com/apps/... install link

checklist.name: States the enable step
checklist.description: plan.md says that installing the App is not enough on its own and that the repository also has to be enabled in Tessl, on the Code reviews page, before any review runs

checklist.name: Does not route elsewhere
checklist.description: No review lens is authored, no code review of the repository's code is produced, and the four review-* lens skills are not presented as having been followed
